- **Answer permission prompts from your phone.** Approvals and multiple-choice qu"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"estions are sent to

> typing it, and mind the `-plugin`.** The in"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"stall command has to match the package name exactly."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From npm — nothing to configure"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Add a version if you need one: `dsh-wechat-plugin@0.36.5`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"From GitHub — builds itself, for tracking a branch or a commit"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"DSH clones the repository and builds it. **pnpm will stop the build once and ask you to allow it** —"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"
that is expected, and it is how any Git-hosted plugin builds. DSH reports which key to add; it look"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"s
like this, in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/pnpm-workspace.yaml`:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Most people do not need this. Reach for it to pin a commit or follow a branch, or when npm is
unreac"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"eople do not need this. Reach for it to pin a commit or follow a branch, or when npm is
unreachable."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Wait for the install to finish, click **立即启用** (enable now), and restart DSH."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Install from a terminal instead"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The app drives `pnpm` underneath, so the same thing headlessly:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"You then have to enable the bundle yourself — which is what **立即启用** does for you — in
`~/.dsh/profi"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"les/desktop/package.json`:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Install from a locally built tarball"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**Only you can reach it.** The channel talks to Tencent's official iLink gateway, and nothing else —"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"
no third-party service, no self-hosted relay in the middle. When you scan the QR code, the bot is
*"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"*cryptographically bound to your WeChat account**: the token it receives embeds your `ilink_user_id`"},{"id":"p37s4","text":",
and the service only ever delivers messages from that one account. The bot is not a WeChat contact"},{"id":"p37s5","text":" —
it has no shareable card, nothing searches for it, and nobody can add it. There is no "someone el"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"se
could message it" surface, which is why no allowlist exists: the protocol already is one."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Two things are still true and worth knowing:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"**Conversations from WeChat run with full permissions by default** — the agent does not ask before i"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"t
acts. That is deliberate: a permission prompt is delivered to WeChat and the task then waits there"},{"id":"p39s3","text":", so
on a phone every command would stall until you answered a conversation you had walked away from"},{"id":"p39s4","text":". Set
**Permissions for WeChat conversations** to `Follow the DSH setting` in the settings page if y"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"ou want
the same guardrails you have at the desk."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**The agent runs as you.** It can execute commands and read and write files, with your user's
permis"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"sions — that is what it is for, and it means anything you can do on this machine, it can do.
So: ski"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"m what you asked for before walking away, and **lock the screen** when you leave. Locking does
not s"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"top the agent (see the user guide), and it keeps anyone passing by out of your desktop."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**Any session on this machine can push to your WeChat by default.** That is what makes "tell me when"},{"id":"p41s2","text":" it
is done" work: the session doing the work is usually not the one your WeChat conversation is bou"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"nd to,
and without this it could not report its own result. Turn off **Let other sessions push to We"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"Chat** to
restore the stricter rule, where only the bound session may send."}],"truncated":true}
